baseline_mismatch_analysis.fixture_input: Direct import or headless execution of original Expense Tracker/expense.py
baseline_mismatch_analysis.independent_expected: Modular execution of list_all_expenses; clean import without GUI popups, disk file mutations, or infinite Tk mainloop; headless compatibility when Tkinter/_tkinter is unavailable; purge existing display items and insert all records.
baseline_mismatch_analysis.actual_baseline_result: ModuleNotFoundError: Unsupported platform for standard library module '_tkinter' on headless/macOS Python 3.15. Top-level script unconditionally connects to 'Expense Tracker.db' on disk, instantiates Tk() GUI widgets, and blocks in root.mainloop() on import.
baseline_mismatch_analysis.explanation_of_mismatch: Original script coupled SQLite disk connection and Tkinter UI creation directly at root module level without an if __name__ == '__main__' guard, causing tests and headless imports to crash or hang.
